name: sleep_effect_hardened
description: Industry-standard replication of the B5 sleep-effect claim. n=30 seeds. Four networks per seed (2 with-sleep, 2 without-sleep) on two independent streams. Bootstrap CI on paired (with_sleep - without_sleep) divergence delta.
details: v1: LeakyRNN (hidden_dim=256, τ=5, target_sr=0.95, α=0.8). Stream length L=5, per-seed sinusoid tasks with log-uniform frequency [0.5, 20] Hz. Wake_phase 200 steps, sleep_phase 600 steps, η=0.01, decay=0.001, ACh gate 0.3. Idle 400 steps. Subspace angle at n=2 and n=3, L2 divergence. Bootstrap 2000 resamples for 95% CI on each paired delta.
